description: This file is a server-side script for a contacts list page in a SvelteKit application. It handles loading contact data from a Django backend via API requests, processes filters, transforms data for frontend use, and manages actions for creating, updating, and deleting contacts.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches contact data from the backend API, applies filters, transforms the data into frontend-compatible format, and returns it along with pagination and filter info.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of new contact entries by sending data to the backend API.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating existing contacts by sending patched data to the backend API.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Deletes a contact via the backend API based on provided contact ID.
